assumptions.choice: Capital is current broker portfolio value at the signal bar; order size is 2% of that value divided by the signal-bar close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires fixed 2% capital sizing but does not define capital or the sizing-price convention before next-bar market execution.

assumptions.choice: The entry execution bar is recorded as bar zero; the time exit is signaled once 10 subsequent bars have elapsed.
assumptions.reason: The specification states held at least 10 bars but does not define whether the entry bar itself counts.

assumptions.choice: The stop-loss sell order is submitted after the entry market order completes, using its actual executed price and executed size.
assumptions.reason: The next-bar market fill price is not known when the entry signal is generated.
